messages:
ash: Retro roguelike mini-tourney this Friday in the mezz? Thinking pixel lineup + shortcuts for quick rounds. Who's bringing what? 

kai: I'm down. Bringing my handheld and a spare USB-C charger. Also have a CRT cable if anyone wants true retro vibes. 

nora: I'll bring pizza and toothpicks (for controller fixes). Also can grab a Switch Lite and a copy of that new indie roguelike. 

devon: counting me in for spectating + tear-down crew. Can bring a cheap projector if needed. Anyone want to do a 15-min speedrun show-and-tell between rounds? 

ash: love it. speedrun show-and-tell yes. quick poll: react with :one: if you prefer old-school pixel roguelikes, :two: if you want party co-op, :three: if you're here for pizza only. 

kai: :one: 

nora: :three: (but will play too) 

devon: :two: for round 1, :one: for round 2. 

snack-bot: Food balance update: nora committed 3 pizzas. Suggested extra: one vegetarian, one gluten-free? Reply with dietary restrictions. 

ash: noted. @nora vegetarian confirmed. @kai any allergy notes? 

kai: nope all good. thanks for checking bot. 

nora: also, the office dock is in the gear locker but needs the HDMI cable replaced. If someone can bring an HDMI-A to mini-HDMI that'd be ideal. 

devon: i have that cable and a battery pack. I'll bring both. 

ash: plan: set up 7pm, pizza 7:30, tourney start 8. Bring controllers and chargers. If you want to stream, i'll throw up a Parsec room and share link 10 mins before. 

kai: i'll test Parsec tonight. ash ping me if you want a dry run. 

nora: raffle idea: winner gets the last slice + a sticker. low stakes. :grin: 

devon: sold. See y'all Friday!
